summary: Backend-only validation for SynCo new features: PUT /api/reference-points/{id}, direct chat (1:1), area chat (broadcast), security (401 on all chat endpoints without token), plus a smoke regression on login/areas/reference-points CRUD/activities. Created /app/backend/tests/test_chat_and_refpoints.py with 29 pytest cases. All 29/29 PASSED against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. The full chat flow (Supervisor -> Topografía -> reply -> Supervisor) works as specified: unread counters increment on send and reset to 0 when the recipient opens the conversation; lastMessage/lastAt/areaName/puesto returned on /chat/users; ascending order on /chat/messages/{peer_id} and /chat/area/{area_id}/messages; area rooms include 'general' + 5 seeded areas with lastMessage/lastFrom updating after sends. Validation rules verified: empty text -> 400, >2000 chars -> 400, to_user==self -> 400, unknown to_user -> 404, unknown area_id -> 404, unknown reference-point id -> 404. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:937 chat_users sorts with reverse=True and lastAt fallback '0'. Works but ties between two users with no messages are sorted by name desc (because reverse=True applies to both keys). Minor UX nit — not a bug.
server.py:973 chat_messages marks ALL incoming peer messages as read on every GET; this is the desired behaviour and is consistent with the unread counter tests.
server.py:1064 chat_area_rooms iterates all areas with N+1 find_one for lastMessage. Acceptable for current scale (5–10 rooms) but consider an aggregation pipeline if areas grow large.
server.py:1098 chat_area_send: area_id is trimmed but body.area_id of 'general ' would still pass area_exists check correctly; OK.
server.py:472 update_reference_point correctly forces especialistas to their own area and prevents duplicates; coordinador can move points between global/area. Behaviour matches spec.
No DELETE endpoint exists for chat messages — confirm with main agent if intentional (likely yes for MVP).
seed_data_creation: Tests insert TEST_-prefixed reference points (cleaned up via teardown_class), TEST_MSG_/TEST_REPLY_ direct chat messages (left in DB; small footprint, easy to filter), and TEST_AREA_* / TEST_ORD_* / TEST_LAST_* area chat messages (left in DB). No production data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_chat_and_refpoints.py -v. Reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env or falls back to /app/frontend/.env. Existing test_coordinator_settings.py and test_noticias.py remain valid for regression. If chat noise needs cleanup, delete documents in db.chat_messages and db.chat_area_messages where text begins with 'TEST_'.
